title.ru: Вежливые просьбы: Could you…? Would you mind…? I'd like…
title.en: Polite requests: Could you…? Would you mind…? I'd like…

pattern.en: Would you mind opening the window?
I'd like a table for two, please.

text.ru: Чем «длиннее», тем вежливее: Can you…? → Could you…? → Would you mind…? После mind — глагол с -ing, а ответ «нет, не против» = No, not at all / Of course not. I want звучит резко — говорите I'd like (= I would like): I'd like to book a room. Разрешение: May I…? / Could I…?
text.en: Longer is politer: Can you…? → Could you…? → Would you mind…? After mind use -ing; “no problem” = No, not at all. I want sounds blunt — say I'd like. Permission: May I…? / Could I…?
text.es: Could you…? / Would you mind + -ing? / I'd like / May I…?

rule.formula: Could you + V? · Would you mind + V-ing? · I'd like + сущ. / to + V · May I + V?

prompt.en: Politely ask the hotel for a late checkout.
